rationale: The agent's own working draft, started before the owner's handoff: say in the model which decisions produce which notification kinds. Never submitted on its own.

operations.description: notification.types.ts, in-memory outbox; ids ntf-N. kind is enrollment-confirmed (sent for a confirmed enrollment) or enrollment-rejected (declared, not sent at rev-4). enrollmentId points at an Enrollment in another module, so it is typed id rather than reference.

operations.statement: A student already enrolled in a course is rejected with ALREADY_ENROLLED, no second seat is taken, and the student receives no notification for the repeat request.
